_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE, hypothetical B2B SaaS startup -- every number here is a scenario assumption, not real company data (unlike data/edgar/*.json, which is real SEC filings). year0 is a beta-launch snapshot; revenue_path is the 5-year ramp a seed/Series-A SaaS business plan might target. benchmark_sector reuses this repo's REAL software peer data (data/edgar/{CSCO,MSFT,ORCL,IBM,ADBE,CRM}.json) to sanity-check whether the assumed exit-year operating margin is anywhere near what real, mature software companies actually report -- the same real data docs/FOOTBALL_FIELD_CSCO.md is built on.
